# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| Latest  | :white_check_mark: |
| < 2.0.0 | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in Adaptive Tab Bar Colour, please report it privately:

1. Navigate to the [Security Advisories tab](https://github.com/atbc-org/Adaptive-Tab-Bar-Colour/security/advisories) on GitHub.
2. Select **Report a vulnerability**.
3. Provide a detailed summary, proof of concept, and affected versions.

Alternatively, contact the maintainers directly via email. Please do not disclose vulnerabilities in public issues or discussions before a fix has been released.
